Tamara Krcmar, Director of Transversal Medical Communication for Cardiometabolic & Venous Diseases at [Servier](https://fr.linkedin.com/company/servier?trk=public_post-text), addresses the challenge of bridging the gap between ideal scenarios and typical patient realities, particularly for those dealing with complex treatment plans such as those for cardiometabolic diseases. In our most recent [#webinar](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fwebinar&trk=public_post-text), she explores different ways that Medical Affairs can improve adherence, and thus the effectiveness of a given treatment plan, including innovative beyond-the-pill solutions Find the full recording for more insights: [https://lnkd.in/dN2SSBNi](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Flnkd%2Ein%2FdN2SSBNi&urlhash=VTvn&trk=public_post-text)[#MedicalAffairs](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fmedicalaffairs&trk=public_post-text)[#CardioMetabolicDiseases](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fcardiometabolicdiseases&trk=public_post-text)[#adherence](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fadherence&trk=public_post-text)

386 followers

 3y  Edited

# NEXT Medical Affairs - Speaking with Tamara Krcmar
## Channel: NEXT Pharma Summit
2.59K subscribers
5 likes

### Description
2,088 views
Posted: 2023-04-18
Welcome to NEXT Medical Affairs, our new podcast initiative where we explore the latest trends and challenges in the rapidly evolving world of medical affairs. 

In the 3rd episode of NEXT Medical Affairs, we speak with Tamara Krcmar - Cardiology Global Medical Communication Lead at Servier. 

Join us as we dive deep into the most pressing issues facing medical affairs professionals today, and explore the cutting-edge strategies and tactics being developed to address them. 

Whether you're seasoned medical affairs professional looking to stay ahead of the curve or a newcomer to the field seeking to learn more, NEXT Medical Affairs has something for you.

So, tune in to our new podcast and stay up-to-date on the latest developments and insights in the world of medical affairs. 

NEXT Medical Affairs is sponsored by Rumi - https://swipehealth.com/rumi

Don't forget to like, share and subscribe to our channel to never miss an episode of NEXT Medical Affairs!

Find more from the ‪@NEXTPharmaSummit‬at: https://nextpharmasummit.com/Lab/
